name: modules-tools-manifest
about: modules.tools 的模块清单不提供绑定声明的方法（HttpModuleClient.ts:65-101）：清单只给 list_tools，绑定要 execute → 每次调用都以 MODULE_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE 的工具错误结束（Module manifest does not provide required method 'execute'.），不发 module_call。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
modules:
  tools:
    enabled: true
    implementationId: bbx.tools
    contract: pilotdeck.tools/v1
    transport: module-http-v2
    endpoint: {MOCK}/tools
    timeoutMs: 1500
    methods:
      - execute
    catalog:
      - name: bbx_echo
        description: Echo text through the external capability module.
        inputSchema:
          type: object
          properties:
            text:
              type: string
          required:
            - text
